Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S25 Search & Sort matches the source-of-truth prototype

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Build design and functionality match the source-of-truth prototype. (TFA-92581 AC 1)
  • U6 Nursing Home identity fields are name, unit/room, MRN and facility. (UAT TC-03)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Prototype screens for the patient list (Daniela's link)

When Compare search and sort placement, sort option labels, search hint text and the Nursing Home card fields side by side, both contexts

Then Matches the prototype as updated for AC 3 (no diagnosis in NH, facility added)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review. Known now: the NH search hint still names diagnosis (S07, S09), the NH card shows the diagnosis line (S09), and no facility exists (S10, S11)

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
